create_stateless_stream: create a fastapi endpoint that streams run events via SSE with auto-created or reused thread
create_stateless_wait: create a fastapi endpoint that blocks until a run completes and returns final state
build_resolve_thread_id: build a helper function that extracts thread_id from request body or generates a new uuid
run_sse_consumer: run the sse_consumer to stream events from a run record to an SSE client
test_stateless_runs: test the stateless runs endpoints for streaming and waiting run behavior
